changelog:
Feishu Image Sender skill v1.0.0 initial release:

- Enables sending local images to Feishu via media messages.
- Automatically triggers when the user requests to send images to Feishu or mentions image file paths (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp).
- Handles file path verification and supported formats (jpg, png, gif, webp).
- Provides guidance for handling Feishu permission errors and authorization.
- Includes usage scenarios, troubleshooting steps, and example code for single or batch image sending.
summary: Send images to Feishu. Activate when user mentions sending images to Feishu, or when message contains image file paths/names (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp).
